title: Ding
blurb: Bell-clear, instantly understood, endlessly applicable. This is the atom from which every other notification sound has been built. An idea arriving, a lift reaching your floor, an order coming up, a point landing squarely in an argument — one clean ding covers all of them. There is no cleverness here and no branding, and the sound does not want anything from you, so it has outlived cleverer competitors. When a moment needs marking and nothing elaborate will do, reach for this. The most honest file in the catalogue. It dings. That is the complete feature set.
origin: One clean bell ding, the universal alert.
